## Changes

### [#212](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/pull/212) Deep links keep every value of a repeated parameter

- A deep link that repeats `credential_types`, as Credentialing Hub depot links do, kept only the last value. The wallet asked for the credential manifest with one type, so an issuer that later offered another type, such as a passport for an ID document depot, had nothing to offer. Every value now reaches the request URI.
- A `vendorOriginContext` with base64 padding was dropped, and one containing `?` or `&` was cut short. It now arrives as sent.
- The request URI keeps its own query as the issuer wrote it, and gets the link's other parameters added to it.

## Backward incompatibilities

- None for links that the Credentialing Hub and the credential agent build. Some hand-written link shapes read differently from 2.10.1: a request URI that repeats `id` ([#213](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/issues/213)), an empty or bare link parameter ([#214](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/issues/214)), and a bare `%` in the request URI's own query, which now throws ([#216](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletAndroid/issues/216)).
